definition: an informal word for a toilet
description: A young woman with long black hair blowing in the wind, dark sunglasses and a long red satin dress sits barefoot on a white toilet in the middle of an empty, cracked white salt flat. She calmly sips from a small glass of coffee, lowers it and looks ahead, a gold cuff on her wrist, and lifts the glass again. There is nothing else around her but the flat crusted ground, low mountains on the horizon and a clear blue sky in bright sunlight.
